messages:
sandeep: FYI support ticket from Acme. They want streaming chat + function/tool calling + structured JSON actions mid-stream. Saying current behavior drops function boundary if we stream. Pinging product/eng to triage.
rachel: Link to ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/90834 — customer is a payments platform, pilot customer, ~120k ARR. They need streaming because UI shows partial results and then tool invocation.
elaine: Thanks. Quick clarifying q's: (1) Is this blocking their launch? (2) Any workaround today?
sandeep: They can fallback to non-streaming but it hurts UX and throughput. Sales says pilot launch depends on streaming experience.
marco: Quick tech note: our streaming fncall prototype currently sends function call frames only at end-of-stream. The customer expects a mid-stream function frame (i.e., partial content -> tool call -> resume streaming). That requires protocol contract + SDK changes and minor runtime plumbing for KV cache flush.
rachel: Example from the ticket (user provided):
```
stream: true
user: "check_order 1234"
expected_frames: ["assistant_partial", "tool_call{action:getOrder,args:{order_id:1234}}", "assistant_final"]
```
elaine: Proposed triage: 1) Scope minimal API contract for mid-stream function frames, include explicit boundary markers; 2) Define SDK behavior (auto-emit tool calls as events); 3) Fallback policy/edge cases; 4) Acceptance tests with Acme.
marco: Rough engineering estimate: 2 sprints for API+SDK+runtime changes if we do a scoped implementation (no new kernel work). Add 1 sprint if we want end-to-end golden tests and perf tuning. Risk: batching and prefix cache semantics need validation.
sandeep: Sales asks for a committed timeline for the pilot launch — can we aim for M+6 weeks if we prioritize?
elaine: Need to prioritize vs other queued streaming asks (we have 3 similar tickets). I'll champion this for pilot customers — propose priority = high for customer pilots, medium for general backlog.
rachel: Also request acceptance criteria from eng: minimal contract spec (includes example frames), SDK snippet (JS + Python) and perf SLO: 95th percentile added latency < 100ms for tool frame emission.
marco: Accept criteria acked: contract + SDK + end-to-end test harness + perf baseline. We can mock tool latency in tests.
elaine: Next steps: marco to write short RFC with API example + edge cases by EOD Thu, then add to product backlog as P1 pilot item. sandeep to confirm pilot commit with Acme. rachel to attach support ticket and sample logs to RFC.
toby-bot: [deployment-bot] created issue REDW-5012 and linked support ticket 90834 :white_check_mark:
rachel: Thanks — I'll add customer contact and sample UI flows.
elaine: OK. If RFC lands and estimate holds, schedule for sprint starting 1865433600. If any change, update this thread. :thumbsup:
marco: I'll post a minimal API example in the RFC.
sandeep: Confirmed customer prefers streaming experience; they're available for pairing tests next week.
elaine: Great — thanks everyone. Closing triage for now, moving to backlog as REDW-5012 (pilot-high).
